hours_changed.text: Hello, this is an automated assistant calling on behalf of the community resource directory. Can I check what we publish for the weekly grocery pickup?
Thank you. We publish it as Wednesdays, nine in the morning until twelve. Is that still right?
That changed, actually. It is ten until one now.
Let me read that back so I have it exactly. Wednesdays, ten in the morning until one in the afternoon. Have I got that right?
Yes, ten to one on Wednesdays is correct.
Thank you, that is very helpful. Have a good afternoon.

program_closed.text: Hello, this is an automated assistant calling on behalf of the community resource directory, about the service you run.
Oh. We are ending that program next month, it closed to new people already.
Thank you for telling me. I will not ask you anything else about that, and I will not change your listing. Someone from the directory will be in touch.
